name: react-navigation-stack-pruner
description: Zero-dependency, version-agnostic helpers to remove intermediate screens from a React Navigation stack (v5, v6, v7, v8) in a single state update.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module commonjs --outDir lib/commonjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module es2020 --outDir lib/module && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir lib/typescript && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('lib/commonjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}');require('fs').writeFileSync('lib/module/package.json','{\"type\":\"module\"}')"
